chapter: Wooden Joe's band and Sidney Correa
title: Wooden Joe's band, John Tassel and its trombonist and drummer
summary: Vincent played in Wooden Joe's band, which was really John Tassel's, and says Joe had an earlier band. He tries to recall its trombone player, linked to Brother Petit's father, and its drummer.
